verdict.rationale: Pomelo is an API platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents API keys, scopes or least-privilege credentials. The only related item covers roles and permissions for Dashboard operators, which is an adjacent human-user control and not scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
